title: CallerReputationProviderStatusEnum
description:
Status of the caller reputation provider integration.

 * `NOT_CONNECTED` - Provider is not connected.
 * `CONNECTING` - Provider is in the process of connecting.
 * `CONNECTED` - Provider is connected.
 * `ACTIVE` - Provider is active and operational.
 * `EXPIRED` - Provider's session or token has expired.
 * `AUTH_FAILED` - Authentication with the provider failed.
 * `PROVIDER_DISABLED` - Provider is disabled.
